footnote_text: Transactions represent the number of shares withheld for the payment of the aggregate exercise price for stock options and tax liabilities.
Reflects the gift of common stock to a charitable donor-advised fund.

On November 15, 2023, the reporting person was granted 124,379 cash-settled phantom stock units, of which 41,459 vested on November 15, 2024 and 41,460 vested on November 15, 2025 and 2026, respectively. These phantom stock units are considered derivative securities settled in cash at a value equal to the number of units vested multiplied by the average closing price per share of common stock of Tutor Perini Corporation (Issuer) during the twenty (20) trading days ending on the applicable vesting date. The reporting person did not purchase or sell any shares of common stock in the settlement of this award, however, the transaction is required to be reported as an acquisition and disposition back to the Issuer under SEC reporting principles.
